Added:


- A smoother onboarding with Autoplan for new users.


Improved:


- Faster sync: Your tasks and calendar refresh as soon as you come back to Sunsama, including after your computer was asleep or offline.
- Autoplan follows your lead: It only adds items from your tools when your braindump asks for them. With the beta on, you can re-plan a day from its review screen.
- Tidier setup: The Gmail, Outlook and Notion setup walkthroughs are more compact and show your progress. Daily Planning's tools window is easier to scan.


Fixed:


- Autoplan now respects your planned times, priorities, recurring tasks and standing rules more reliably.
- Pressing Enter on an @-mention in a comment now picks the teammate instead of posting the comment.
- Daily highlights describe the work in GitHub pull requests again, instead of only saying "approved and merged."
- Sunny no longer strips harmless links, like GitHub, Google and Teams links, from its replies and summaries.


In progress:


- You may have already noticed, we're building richer previews for the tools you connect to Sunsama, so you can read, edit and reply to more of your work without leaving the app. More soon!
